native_review.reviewer: Codex root; single implementation and review lane
findings: Neutral source views show layered sleeves and shoulders rather than exposed spheres; native views show fitted torso, bracers, boots and split coats on both foe families.
NPC tailoring is visible in native front views; the R2 inherited strip-like neck connection is replaced by a continuous neck/collar on all nine ambient NPCs.
Actual mixed neck/head vertices retain volume and attachment in idle/walk; focus acceptance passes.
Existing face paint, named NPC full costumes and foe S357 face shapes retain their established appearance.
No newly detached head/neck, runaway body or collapsed attack/death pose was observed in reviewed R3 captures.
limits: Original stylized proportions, shared ambient facial paint and existing idle/walk clips remain; this is not a facial-rig or animation overhaul.
Some old ambient idle poses keep arms close to/behind the torso; their unchanged source animation is retained.
HUD notifications and ordinary canopy occlusion remain in some shots; dedicated views establish body/neck quality.
